_comment: Your weekly timetable. Copy this file to schedule.json and replace the example classes with your own.
Times are local, 24-hour (09:30, 14:00). Days: sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat.
Each class: start, end, course (English name), course_ar (the Arabic name Moodle shows), section, mode,
and optionally label (shown text) and place (e.g. Room 2147 - leave it out for Online/Activity).
mode is one of: In-Person, Online, Activity. Lecture reminders go out for the modes in remind_modes.
course_codes: the course number on the portal -> the English course name (used for files and grades).
portal_aliases: a different name Moodle uses -> the English name above.
degree_hours (optional): the credit hours of your whole degree plan, e.g. 132 (shows remaining hours); null = not shown.
auto_check_in (optional): true = the bot checks you in to every online lecture (ك, live on Teams) as soon as
the instructor opens attendance - never an In-Person or Activity day. It reads which days are online from the
portal's own timetable by itself (needs PORTAL_USERNAME and PORTAL_PASSWORD in .env), else from ZUJ's codes in
the attendance's name, then from this file, then from the ك at the end of the Moodle course name.
It sends the proof (a screenshot); false or left out = off.
The bot checks this file whenever it changes and tells you on Telegram if something is wrong.
